row.team_price_text: Team: $15/u/mo billed annually ($19 monthly), 2 user min
row.evidence: Fathom's pricing page lists "SSO & SCIM provisioning" under Enterprise ("Talk to sales"), and the feature table marks Single sign-on and Okta SCIM provisioning for Enterprise only.
row.notes: New row; Fathom AI meeting assistant (fathom.ai / fathom.video). Team $15 and Business $25 per user/mo billed annually ($19/$34 monthly), both with a 2-user minimum; Premium ($16/$20) is single-user. SAML SSO (any IdP) and SCIM are Enterprise (Contact Sales); SAML is enabled by Fathom support. SCIM works through the Okta OIN app (OAuth 2.0 connection) and, since Sept 2026, through an Entra non-gallery app using an OAuth2 client-credentials Tenant URL that Fathom support must turn on; the July 2026 SAML article still says Okta only (conflict). SCIM creates, updates (first/last name, email, timezone), deactivates (recordings kept) and syncs team membership via push groups; roles and view access stay manual in Fathom. The public API (all plans incl. Free, 60 calls/min) is read-only for users: account admins can list users with permissions, teams and team members.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: For individuals; not a team plan.

auth.token_source: Okta: OIN app Provisioning tab, approve the OAuth 2.0 connection. Entra: Settings > Organization Settings > Access Controls > Microsoft Entra ID Provisioning > Configure (Tenant URL, token endpoint, client ID, client secret)

operations.notes: Docs describe outcomes, not HTTP methods. 'User activated and added to Push Group' creates or reactivates the Fathom user.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users can no longer log in; their Team membership and recordings are kept. Removing a user from a push group only unlinks the Team membership.

group: Team membership via push groups (Okta can rename Fathom Teams)

roles.how: Roles (Admin vs standard) and view access are set manually in Fathom after provisioning; new SCIM users get Standard seats.

limitations.text: One group mapping per user (first mapping wins); a user cannot be mapped to multiple Teams.
With SCIM on, in-app invites are disabled; users must be added through IdP groups.
Connecting SCIM runs an immediate email-matched backfill with no preview, which can change Team membership.
Entra SCIM and SSO must be switched on by Fathom support; the Entra gallery 'Fathom' apps are unrelated and do not provision.
Role and view-access assignment are not synced.

scim.notes: No SCIM base URL, version or endpoint list is published; Okta uses the OIN app's OAuth 2.0 connection and Entra uses a Tenant URL plus OAuth2 client credentials generated in Settings > Organization Settings > Access Controls.

auth.notes: User-level API keys in the X-Api-Key header, or Bearer tokens from a registered OAuth app.

capabilities.notes: The documented API has only GET endpoints for users, teams and team members; no write endpoints for people exist in the OpenAPI spec.

endpoints.purpose: List users and their permissions (account admin only; filter by team, status, settings_access)

rate_limits.text: 60 calls per minute per user across all of their API keys; higher limits not offered.

limitations.text: GET /users needs an API key belonging to an account admin.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Jul 2023) marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (read from rendered page markup).

entra.notes: Provisioning uses a customer-created non-gallery app; Fathom says the gallery apps named Fathom are unrelated.

fallbacks.notes: Without SCIM, admins invite members by email and set admin/standard status and team.
